title: Client integration tactical snapshot - 2026-06-28
summary: Weekly tactical notes from the Solutions Engineering + ProServices sync. Focus this week: unblock two active customers with API auth and schema issues, validate Dedicated capacity sizing for Nimbus Retail POC, and triage latency spikes observed in a small percentage of ClearBay Health requests.
attendees: Customer reps: Priya Shah (Nimbus), Luis Ramos (ClearBay)
agenda: Quick round-robin status (3 min per customer)
Deep dive: ClearBay Health latency triage
Dedicated capacity sizing ask from Nimbus Retail
Next week priorities and risk register updates
notes:
Round-robin highlights:

Nimbus Retail (POC):
- Current status: Connector demo successful; production auth not completed. Customer is waiting on token exchange flow to be enabled by their security team.
- Blocker: Nimbus requires mutual TLS for the token endpoint; our current hosted onboarding flow uses regular OAuth2 token exchange only.
- Temporary workaround agreed: enable a short-lived customer-specific ingress with mTLS routing to allow the POC while engineering scopes a secure, deployable solution.
- Risks: If mTLS path takes >10 days, Nimbus will not sign the Dedicated contract this quarter.

ClearBay Health:
- Current status: Integration live with low throughput (spike traffic 02:00 UTC on 06/26 triggered latency spikes).
- Triage findings: 18% of requests hit a code path that triggers a synchronous KV-cache reload (legacy behavior) under specific prompt length patterns. This causes a burst of CPU+GPU memory churn and increased tail latency.
- Action taken: We rolled a canary that forces async cache warm on affected nodes; initial A/B shows 70% reduction in tail latency events in the cohort. Still seeing rare >450ms token latencies tied to GC cycles on older nodes.
- Next: SRE to schedule rolling replace of oldest instance types and add a cache-warm metric to alerting.

Quill Financial (early onboarding):
- Current status: Schema mismatch between Quill's JSON LLM-output schema and our structured output validation step. Several fields are being dropped by the validation hook.
- Mitigation: We pushed a short-lived validation-toggle flag for Quill so outputs bypass strict schema while we update the validator to support nested optional arrays.
- Owner: Hannah to deliver validator patch (PR referenced in linked artifacts) and coordinate tests with Quill's eng by 2026-07-02.

General operational items:
- Dedicated sizing: Miguel presented preliminary capacity calc for Nimbus Dedicated pool (baseline 8xA100 equiv for latency SLA at 2k rps). Proposal to start with 4 nodes + autoscaler rules for burst. We need finance signoff on reserve commitment model.
- Observability: Jonah proposed a short-lived token-level sampling to capture full request traces for ClearBay spike windows — approved for one week only (privacy-cleared).
- Documentation: Update onboarding checklist to include mTLS opt-in steps and schema-versioning guidance. Samir to update runbook by 2026-07-01.
